name: Container grow (tile to card)
visual_intent: An object becomes its expanded view: a tile, chip or button grows into the card or screen it opens, so the viewer never loses the thing they were looking at.

performance_characteristics.dom_node_count: 1 proxy + styled snapshots of both contents
performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low; layout-property tween on one box, snapshot size grows with the target's subtree (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: A proxy box tweens left, top, width, height, corner radius, background and shadow from the source box at the cue to the target box at the hand-off. Styled snapshots (computed style inlined, ids dropped) of the source and target contents cross over inside it: source out in the first 30 %, target in, rising, in the last 40 %. Then the real target is shown, the proxy hidden and the scenes cut.
runtime_api: Studio.fx.containerTransform(tl, fromEl, toEl, at, {duration, ease, color, shadow, outTarget, inTarget})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html (proxy between the boxes, contents never mixed, styled copies, landing box, hand-off, no duplicate ids, seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; frame review tests/reference-derived/flash-and-container/qa/report.json (0 errors). Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
